headline: Nanoleaf’s colorful pegboard and shelf kit is half off
summary: Nanoleaf's Blocks Combo XL kit is 50% off, now $99.99. It combines smart lighting panels with a low-profile shelf and pegboard. This deal offers customizable light and storage for walls.

headline: Why China is giving away its best AI models
summary: China's Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 is challenging US AI models. It allegedly beats top US systems at a fraction of the cost. This move intensifies the global AI rivalry.

headline: YouTube Premium will include Peacock starting next year
summary: YouTube Premium subscribers will gain access to Peacock. The multi-year deal starts in 2027. Users can stream Peacock's ad-supported content directly via the YouTube app.

headline: Amazon’s trying to launch a global satellite cellphone network in 2028
summary: Amazon filed an FCC application for a global satellite network. It plans to deploy 5,105 satellites starting in 2028. This service aims to provide direct-to-device voice, messaging, data, and emergency services.

headline: Physical 'Copies' of GTA 6 Will Expire 170 Days After Launch Date in Japan
summary: Physical copies of GTA 6 in Japan will have an expiration date. Download codes included will expire 170 days after launch. Buyers must activate quickly to avoid losing access.

headline: The MSI Codex R2 GeForce RTX 5070 Prebuilt Gaming PC Drops to Just $1,399.99
summary: The MSI Codex R2 gaming PC with an RTX 5070 is now $1,399.99. It's an excellent prebuilt option for 1080p and 1440p gaming. The system is also capable of running games in 4K.

headline: The $1,800 Power Lift Recliner and Massage Chair Drops to $350 at Wayfair After a Massive 80% Discount
summary: An $1,800 power lift recliner and massage chair is now $350. Wayfair is offering a massive 80% discount on the item. This chair provides comfort and assistance, despite its gaming website listing.

headline: The 4K-Ready MSI Codex Z2 GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC Drops to $1,699 After a $600 Discount
summary: The 4K-ready MSI Codex Z2 gaming PC is now $1,699. It features a GeForce RTX 5070 Ti and is discounted by $600. This deal offers significant savings, as the GPU alone costs nearly $1,000.

headline: Wildfire now nine miles away from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
summary: A wildfire is now nine miles from Bordeaux, France. The mayor warns of potential further evacuations. A nearby mayor described the situation as "catastrophic."

headline: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
summary: Devastating wildfires are raging across Europe. A blaze near Bordeaux has consumed over 162 sq miles in four days. The Madrid region is experiencing its worst fires ever.

headline: Funeral director who left people unburied breached families' trust 'on industrial scale', court hears
summary: A funeral director is on trial for leaving people unburied. The court heard his parlor was likened to a "horror scene." He is accused of breaching families' trust "on an industrial scale."

headline: Reform UK reporting Green leader Zack Polanski to police over Instagram post
summary: Reform UK is reporting Green leader Zack Polanski to the police. The complaint concerns an Instagram post. It featured a man wearing a top with the name 'Nigel' alongside a guillotine image.
